_about: Alice Gardner (1854-1927), Newnham College historian: Julian, Philosopher and Emperor (Heroes of the Nations, 1895) and The Lascarids of Nicaea (1912; the only scan is the 1964 Hakkert photographic reprint). Theodore of Studium (1905) is left for lane A; her essays and Erigena study are outside lane B. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dj). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
